lines.zh: 我四条腿落在地上，很稳
lines.en: My four legs find the ground, steady.

lines.zh: 恶地的碎石在我脚下响
lines.en: Badland gravel sounds under my feet.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在身后左右摆
lines.en: My tail swings left and right behind me.

lines.zh: 我低着头，沿着一道干沟走
lines.en: I walk head low along a dry gully.

lines.zh: 我身边还有几只，走成一群
lines.en: A few more walk with me as a herd.

lines.zh: 我的皮很厚，走起来沙沙响
lines.en: My hide is thick and rustles as I move.

lines.zh: 我一步一步地量着这片红土
lines.en: I measure this red earth step by step.
I smell water and change direction.

lines.zh: 我蹭过一丛干枯的灌木
lines.en: I brush past a clump of dead brush.

lines.zh: 我的脖子很长，抬起很慢
lines.en: My neck is long and rises slowly.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块倒下的岩柱
lines.en: I go around a fallen rock pillar.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌在沙上留下深坑
lines.en: My feet leave deep pits in the sand.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方尘土半天不落
lines.en: Dust hangs long where I pass.

lines.zh: 我跟在最小的那只旁边
lines.en: I walk beside the smallest of the herd.

lines.zh: 我站在晒热的岩石边上
lines.en: I stand by a sun-hot rock.

lines.zh: 我的头抬着，慢慢看四周
lines.en: My head is up, scanning slowly.

lines.zh: 一群体在我附近低头吃
lines.en: The herd grazes near me.
There is a layer of dust on my hide.

lines.zh: 我把重量移到后面两条腿
lines.en: I shift my weight to my hind legs.

lines.zh: 风从背脊上过去，沙跟着走。
lines.en: Wind crosses my spine, and sand follows.

lines.zh: 我慢慢嚼着嘴里的东西
lines.en: I chew slowly.
My shadow shrinks under me.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，风里有别的味道
lines.en: I lift my head; the wind carries another smell.
I rub my head against the rock.
I half-close my eyes and breathe slowly.

lines.zh: 一只小兽从我脚边跑过
lines.en: A small creature darts past my feet.
I tuck my legs under my body.

lines.zh: 晒热的石头贴着我的腹
lines.en: The hot rock warms my belly.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，比你高出很多
lines.en: I raise my head, far above you.
You do not look ready to strike.
My herd is backing away.
I lower my head and stand in front.

lines.zh: 红土上，我的鼻孔喷出灰。
lines.en: My nostrils puff dust across the red clay.
I don't like being stared at.
I do not move; I only stare.
Nothing sharp in your hands.

lines.zh: 我的族群在我后面排开
lines.en: My herd fans out behind me.
On the red earth, my nostrils puff dust.
If you walk away, I will not follow.
I raise my neck to look taller.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，脚下碎石滑动
lines.en: I give half a step, gravel sliding.
My head tilts, then straightens.
My breathing roughens.

lines.zh: 族群里有一只叫了一声
lines.en: One of the herd calls out.
I lower my head and breathe hard.
A gash has opened in my hide.
I give half a step and dust rises.
I crouch low and cover my flank.
The herd closes around me.
I draw my neck back a little.
That in your hand is plant matter.
I extend my head slowly.
My mouth is large; be careful.

lines.zh: 你手里的叶子，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the leaves in your hand.
I can chew this.
I reach over and open my mouth slowly.
I will not eat much; I stop when full.
Such a smell is rare in the badlands.
My tongue is thick and curls slowly.
Step back and I will not pursue.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的腿上，弹开了
lines.en: You hit my leg and rebound.
My body is a thick wall.
Dirt lifts as you step back.
I shift a foot and the ground answers.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，你的肩膀被我挤开
lines.en: We collide and my bulk shoves your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我一挪腿，你站的地方就没了
lines.en: I shift a leg and your footing is gone.
My tail brushes your waist.

lines.zh: 你退开时，脚下沙滑了一下
lines.en: You step back and the sand slides.

lines.zh: 我只是站着，是你撞上来的
lines.en: I only stand; you were the one who hit me.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖撞在我的脚趾上
lines.en: Your knee hits my toe.
She walks at the front of the herd.
Our heads come together.

lines.zh: 她比我高一点，皮色更深
lines.en: She is a little taller, her hide darker.
We lower our heads to graze together.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴碰了她的尾巴
lines.en: My tail touches hers.
She rubs her head against my neck.

lines.zh: 我们一起把尘土抖起来
lines.en: We shake the dust up together.

lines.zh: 她走在我外侧，替我挡风
lines.en: She walks on my outer side, blocking the wind.

lines.zh: 我们的脚印在沙上重叠
lines.en: Our prints overlap in the sand.

lines.zh: 我们一起朝同一块岩石走
lines.en: We walk toward the same rock.
I lower my head, neck to the ground.
My mouth takes it easily.
I shake it twice to shed the soil.
I drop it in the middle of the herd.
I bend my neck into an arc.
I carry it two steps.
I pick up a branch and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 我把它吐在地上看了看
lines.en: I spit it out and look.
I curl it up with my tongue.
I press it down by my foot.

lines.zh: 恶地的干土，磨平了我的牙。
lines.en: Badland dust wore my teeth flat.
My herd has scattered.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴停在半空不动
lines.en: My tail halts in midair.
I press my weight forward.
I bend my long neck down.

lines.zh: 我的族群让开一块空地
lines.en: My herd makes an open space.

lines.zh: 我把前脚往前挪了一步
lines.en: I move a forefoot one step forward.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸把地上的灰吹起
lines.en: My breath lifts the dust.
I am in no hurry; you cannot outrun me.
I lift my tail and set it down.
This ground is mine now.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，脖子形成影子
lines.en: I look down, my neck throwing shadow.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里有低低的声音
lines.en: A low sound sits in my throat.

lines.zh: 你退到岩壁，那里没有路
lines.en: You back to the cliff; there is no way.

lines.zh: 我一步一步往前走，不急
lines.en: I come forward step by step, unhurried.
My shadow drags over you.
You retreat to the rocks; it is narrow there.

lines.zh: 我低着头，脖子伸得很长
lines.en: I keep my head low, neck extended.
I bear forward step by step.

lines.zh: 我的影子先到你的脚边
lines.en: My shadow reaches your feet first.
You go round the rock; I go round outside.

lines.zh: 我不跑，我的体重就是速度
lines.en: I do not run; my weight is my speed.
My tail sways at your flank.

lines.zh: 地上的碎石被我踩进土里
lines.en: I press the gravel into the ground.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在身后扫起红土。
lines.en: My tail sweeps red dust behind me.
Three of my steps away.

lines.zh: 我的头一直低着，对着你
lines.en: My head stays low, aimed at you.

lines.zh: 我不发声，声音会惊到族群
lines.en: I make no sound; it would spook the herd.
The path behind you has narrowed.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来，挡住太阳
lines.en: I turn my flank to block the sun.
The further you back, the nearer the cliff.

lines.zh: 恶地的土硬，我的头更硬。
lines.en: Badlands soil is hard. My skull harder.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴抽在你的膝弯。
lines.en: My tail cracks across the back of your knee.
My forefoot comes down.
I shove you with my flank.
My head slams into your chest.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴抽在你的侧腰
lines.en: My tail whips your flank.
My forefoot lands by your foot.

lines.zh: 我用肩把你推到岩壁上
lines.en: I shoulder you into the rock.
My mouth catches your sleeve.
I turn and my tail base hits you.
You block once and slide far back.

lines.zh: 我抬脚再踩，地上一个坑
lines.en: I raise a foot again; a pit remains.
My breath blows across your face.

lines.zh: 我撞空了一次，石头碎了
lines.en: I miss once and a stone shatters.
I lower my head and butt you.
You grab my hide and cannot hold.
A cloud of red dust rises in the distance.
I come on, heavy step by step.
The herd follows behind me.
I bring my nose to the red earth.

lines.zh: 我从岩脊后走出来，鼻息很重。
lines.en: I walk out from behind the ridge, breathing hard.

lines.zh: 我把脚在地上顿了一下
lines.en: I stamp one foot down.
I begin as a cloud of dust.
I step out of the dust, heavy.
The herd spreads to both my sides.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看这片恶地
lines.en: I lower my head to this badland.

lines.zh: 太阳把我的背照得发亮
lines.en: The sun shines on my back.
I break a crust of dry earth.
I stretch my neck up and sniff.
I stop between two rocks.

lines.zh: 恶地的风把沙吹进我的眼睛。
lines.en: Badland wind blows sand into my eyes.
I call once, very low.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的皮，我甩了甩身体
lines.en: Fire catches my hide and I shake myself.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，压碎一片石
lines.en: I roll down the slope, shattering stone.

lines.zh: 水没到我的背，我抬头喘
lines.en: Water reaches my back and I lift my head to breathe.

lines.zh: 爆风把我推得侧了过去
lines.en: The blast shoves me sideways.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我的皮，很浅
lines.en: Something lodges shallow in my hide.

lines.zh: 那股力量钻透我的皮肉
lines.en: That force drives through my hide.

lines.zh: 草不够，我的肋骨显出来
lines.en: Not enough plants; my ribs show.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的背上，我整只都麻了
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and numbs me whole.

lines.zh: 红土没了，我的腿在空里蹬
lines.en: The red earth is gone; my legs kick at nothing.
